synopsis: AVL SCENIUS is a commercial scenario tool supporting the lifecycle from requirements through creation, planning, execution and reporting within an open scenario-based verification and validation tool chain [f8630, f8631, f16022]. The corpus lists it among scenario-generation and test-management offerings [f8361]. The glossary connects AVL's SCENIUS and scenario-based validation services with explicit work in agriculture, forestry, construction and mining, but Chapter 11 distinguishes AVL's broader off-road work from tool-specific evidence: neither off-road evidence nor a heavy-machine deployment of SCENIUS was found [f16099, f9189, f8632]. Pricing and release information also remain gaps: no public price or latest release was found [f9191, f9192].
